title: Diary One X02 V04.1 Preview with Model-owned Storyline V03 with Chapter Media V01
description: Research-only V04.1 contract. semantic_day_state is the content truth and delivery_state is the delivery/readiness truth. The deprecated output_mode projection exists only for V04 client migration and must not be used to infer whether content absence and delivery failure are the same state. Chapter display requires three to five materials; media selection is separate from grouping.

unresolved_asset_ids.description: Must exactly equal decision_trace.perception_batching.unresolved_asset_ids; exact cross-location value equality is asserted by the V04.1 contract tests.

semantic_day_state.description: Semantic result derived from grounded selectable memory content, independent of copy or delivery failures.

delivery_state.description: Current preview delivery/readiness state. This must not rewrite semantic_day_state.

output_mode.description: Deprecated V04 compatibility projection only. Consumers must use semantic_day_state plus delivery_state for state truth.

selected_memory_outcomes.description: One row per S09-selected memory. Published chapters/ahas must exactly equal the media-ready, surface-verified rows by memory_type; that cross-array identity is asserted by the V04.1 contract tests.

model_call_attempt_count.description: Whole X02 V04.1 run count across Perception, Structure, and Writer provider-call attempts; not an S04-only count.

unresolved_asset_ids.description: Must exactly equal the top-level unresolved_asset_ids array.

focus_code.description: Optional legacy annotation, retained as an empty string when absent. Not a grouping, ranking or independence signal.
